Ken42 University offers various scholarships for the academic year 2025-26. Here are the different types of scholarships available:

**General Policy Information:**
*   Scholarships are awarded based on merit and are available for limited seats.
*   The University's Management has sole discretion to modify or abandon any scholarship.
*   The Vice Chancellor is the final authority for all scholarship decisions.
*   Scholarships are not automatically renewed; decisions are made every semester on a case-to-case basis.
*   Students are generally eligible for only one scholarship type/concession in a given academic semester or year. If multiple criteria are met, the highest scholarship will be awarded.

**Scholarship Types:**

1.  **Entry Level Scholarship (For UG Program):**
    *   **Basis:** Board Merit/JEE/CUET/CLAT AIR (General) score.
    *   **Applicability:** First year tuition fee only. Not applicable for Global Pathway Programs.
    *   **Total Seats:** Up to 3000, awarded in order of merit.
    *   **Tiers:** Vary for Girls and Boys, and for Indian vs. International Boards, based on percentages in 12th Board Marks, JEE/CUET percentile, CLAT AIR, SAT, IB, or CIE scores. Scholarships range from 10% to 30% of the first year tuition fee.
    *   **Armed Forces Ward Reservation:** 25 seats reserved for wards of Armed Forces personnel.

2.  **Special Scholarship for Liberal Studies Programs - First 100 Admissions:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** B.Sc. (Hons.) Economics and Finance, B.Sc. (Hons.) Economics with Data Science, B.Sc. (Hons.) Psychology and Behaviour.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 10% scholarship on Tuition Fee for the first year, over and above the entry-level scholarship.

3.  **Special B.Tech (Mathematics and Computing) Scholarship:**
    *   **Program Count:** Up to 30 Admissions.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 30% scholarship on Tuition Fee for the first year on a first-come-first-serve basis.

4.  **Scholarship Program for MBA:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** MBA programs (regular), except Global Pathway Program (GPP).
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 20% scholarship per semester on tuition fee for the first year only.
    *   **Eligibility:** Minimum 80% marks in graduation OR CAT score 85 percentile and above OR NMAT score greater than 200.
    *   **Total Seats:** Up to 100, awarded on a first-cum-first-serve basis.

5.  **Domicile Scholarship:**
    *   **Objective:** Support students from Karnataka.
    *   **Reservation:** 25% seats reserved for Karnataka domicile students.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 25% scholarship on the tuition fee per semester.
    *   **Document Required:** Submission of Domicile Certificate.
    *   **GPP Eligibility:** Students in Global Pathway Programs are also eligible.

6.  **Jyoti Scholarship (Freeships):**
    *   **Objective:** 100% scholarship (includes tuition and other academic fee) for meritorious students from underprivileged backgrounds.
    *   **Total Seats:** 51 seats for regular programs on merit basis.
    *   **Age Limit:** UG: 20 years; PG: 25 years.
    *   **Eligibility:** Minimum 80% Marks in 10th and 12th, and family income not more than Rupees eight lakh per annum.
    *   **Renewal:** Based on academic performance (minimum 6.0 SGPA/CGPA), no disciplinary cases, renewed income certificate, and 75% attendance.

7.  **Vijay Scholarship (Sports):**
    *   **Objective:** Develop sports culture and support talented sportspersons.
    *   **Tiers:**
        *   International (Medal holders): 100% on Tuition fees.
        *   International (Participating): 75% on Tuition fees.
        *   National (Medal holders/4th place): 50% on Tuition fees.
        *   National (Participation): 35% on Tuition fees.
    *   **Seats per Sport:** Specific numbers for Football, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Shooting, Chess, Athletics, Boxing, Wrestling, Archery.
    *   **Selection:** Physical/fitness and skill test, verification of testimonials, in-person interview.
    *   **Applicability:** Only on Tuition Fee.

8.  **Fellowship for M.Tech & M.Des Students:**
    *   **M.Tech. Program:**
        *   **GATE Scholarship:** Up to Rupees twelve thousand four hundred per month for students with a valid GATE score of 75 percentile and above.
        *   **Research Grant:** Up to Rupees fifty thousand towards outcome-based research.
    *   **M.Des. Program:**
        *   **Teaching Assistantship:** Up to Rupees three thousand per month.
    *   **General Eligibility:** Minimum CGPA of 8.5, no supplementary exams, 75% attendance, no disciplinary action.

9.  **Scholarships Based on Academic Performance – From Second Year Onwards:**
    *   **Applicability:** Undergraduate, postgraduate, and global pathway programs.
    *   **Qualifying CGPA:** Minimum 8.5 CGPA.
    *   **Award Percentage:** Awarded to 10% of total students enrolled in each program.
    *   **Tiers:** 1st in merit (20% on tuition fees), 2nd in merit (15% on tuition fees), Rest of eligible students (10% on tuition fees).
    *   **Conditions:** Passed without supplementary exams, 75% attendance, no disciplinary action.

10. **Student Financial Support – We Care initiative by Ken42:**
    *   **Objective:** Financial support for students who lost an earning parent after admission and after submitting full fees for at least one semester.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** Relaxation of Rupees fifty thousand towards tuition fee per semester.
    *   **Eligibility:** No NC (Not Clear) or Backlog, no disciplinary action.

11. **Alumni Scholarship:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** All regular PG programs, Part-Time Ph.D. Programs.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 50% tuition fee waiver for the full duration.
    *   **Eligibility:** Alumni graduated from 2020 onwards (special approval for earlier graduates). Must meet admission eligibility criteria.

12. **Employee Ward Scholarship:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** Regular UG, PG, and Part-Time Ph.D. programs.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 75% scholarship on the Semester Fee (Inclusive of Tuition and Academics Service fee).
    *   **Eligibility:** Wards of regular and confirmed Ken42 employees (maximum two children).

13. **Employee Sibling Ward Scholarship:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** Regular UG, PG, and Part-Time Ph.D. programs.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 50% scholarship on the Semester Fee (Inclusive of Tuition and Academics Service fee).
    *   **Eligibility:** Wards of siblings of regular and confirmed Ken42 employees (maximum two children).

14. **Employee Spouse Scholarship:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** Regular UG, PG, and Part-Time Ph.D. programs.
    *   **Scholarship Value:** 50% scholarship on the Semester Fee (Inclusive of Tuition and Academics Service fee).
    *   **Eligibility:** Spouse of regular and confirmed Ken42 employees.

15. **Scholarships for International Students:**
    *   **Applicable Programs:** UG (12th Overall Marks - Not applicable for LLB three-Years), PG (Only for MBA).
    *   **Duration:** Entire duration of course, subject to conditions.
    *   **Tiers (UG):** Based on 12th Overall Marks, ranging from 10% to 30% on full fee.
    *   **Tiers (PG - MBA):** 20% scholarship on full fee for minimum 60% marks in Graduation.
    *   **Conditions:** Passed every semester without supplementary, 75% attendance, no disciplinary action.

16. **Scholarships for Online Students (UPESONLINE):**
    *   **Academic Scholarship:**
        *   **UG:** 10% for 75-85% in 12th Std., 15% for >85%.
        *   **PG:** Based on Work Experience & Graduation marks (10% for 3 years WE, 15% for 5 years WE, 20% for 10+ years WE, all with >55% in Graduation).
    *   **Scholarship for Alumni:** 20% scholarship on program fee for degree programs.
    *   **Employee Ward Scholarship:** Discretionary amount based on special approval.

For detailed eligibility criteria and conditions for each scholarship, please refer to the Ken42 Scholarship Policy.

Ken42 University offers Entry Level Scholarships for UG Programs based on Board Merit/JEE/CUET/CLAT AIR scores for boys. These scholarships are applicable to the first year tuition fee only and are not for Global Pathway Programs.

Here are the tiers for boys:
*   **thirty percent scholarship:** greater than or equal to ninety-five percent in twelfth Board Marks OR greater than or equal to ninety-five percent in J E E / C U E T percentile OR CLAT AIR one to one thousand.
*   **twenty-five percent scholarship:** ninety point zero one to ninety-four point nine nine percent in twelfth Board Marks OR CLAT AIR one thousand one to three thousand.
*   **twenty percent scholarship:** ninety point zero one to ninety-four point nine nine percent in J E E / C U E T percentile OR CLAT AIR three thousand one to five thousand.
*   **fifteen percent scholarship:** eighty point zero one to ninety percent in twelfth Board Marks OR CLAT AIR five thousand one to seven thousand.
*   **ten percent scholarship:** seventy-five to eighty percent in twelfth Board Marks OR eighty to ninety percent in J E E / C U E T percentile OR CLAT AIR seven thousand one to nine thousand.

For International Boards, the tiers for boys are:
*   **thirty percent scholarship:** greater than or equal to ninety-five percent in twelfth Overall Marks OR greater than or equal to ninety-five percent in C U E T score OR one thousand four hundred & above in S A T.
*   **twenty-five percent scholarship:** ninety point zero one to ninety-four point nine nine percent in twelfth Overall Marks OR one thousand three hundred to one thousand three hundred ninety-nine in S A T OR seven in I B OR A* in C I E.
*   **twenty percent scholarship:** ninety point zero one to ninety-four point nine nine percent in C U E T score OR one thousand two hundred to one thousand two hundred ninety-nine in S A T OR six in I B OR A in C I E.
*   **fifteen percent scholarship:** eighty point zero one to ninety percent in twelfth Overall Marks OR five in I B OR B in C I E.
*   **ten percent scholarship:** seventy-five to eighty percent in twelfth Overall Marks OR eighty to ninety percent in C U E T score.

Please note that scholarships are available for limited seats (up to three thousand total for Entry Level) and are awarded in order of merit. Students are generally eligible for only one scholarship type/concession in a given academic semester or year. If multiple criteria are met, the highest scholarship will be awarded.
